title: Save any link instantly
description: Paste a URL or press Ctrl+V anywhere in the app. Purl fetches the title, favicon, and full content automatically.

title: Deep PDF understanding
description: Upload a PDF and Purl reads the full document, so it's there whenever you need it.

title: Connect any AI Agent
description: Plug Purl into Claude, Cursor, or VS Code over the MCP. Your agent can search and save to your library directly.

title: Build with the API
description: Save links, search, and pull your content into your own scripts and tools with a simple REST API and a Purl key.
